image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a classic car wheel featuring a whitewall tire and a highly polished chrome rim with a red pinstripe accent. The wheel is mounted on a glossy black vehicle fender which reflects the surroundings. The tire shows distinct tread patterns and sidewall texture. The rim has a deep dish design with visible lug nuts in the center hub.

artifact_observations.location: Reflections on the black fender (left side)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The reflections on the glossy black bodywork are slightly smeared and lack the sharp geometric fidelity expected from a real-world mirror reflection, suggesting minor AI generation artifacts in the environment mapping.

The lug nuts in the center hub are somewhat indistinct and merge slightly with the surrounding chrome. They lack the precise, separate mechanical definition of real hardware, appearing slightly 'melted' into the hub face.

To verify the boundary between the metal rim and the rubber tire is sharp and physically continuous, checking for bleeding or fusion artifacts common in AI generations.
To analyze the depth consistency of the recessed hub vs. the raised lip and ensure the reflections on the fender correspond to a valid 3D spatial arrangement.
To specifically audit the complex reflections on the chrome rim and black fender for logical consistency and absence of warping/melting artifacts.

Sharpness of the boundary between the whitewall tire and the rim
Mechanical plausibility of the center hub and lug nuts
Consistency of the tire tread pattern geometry
